title: Chapter 538
text:
In the plaza of the dock, many wanderers and galactic pirates who stayed on Floating Dragon Island surrounded the BlackLight Stealth and pointed at it. Their eyes were filled with envy and greed.

The spaceship of the Radiant Federation, a high-end product!

Unfortunately, this expensive spaceship belonged to Black Star. On Floating Dragon Island, not many people dared to mess around with it. They only dared to look at it.

"Move aside."

Han Xiao's voice sounded from outside the crowd. The hundreds of people around the spaceship all turned to look, and their faces turned pale. Everyone hurriedly took a few steps back as though they had seen a ghost. Many pairs of eyes looked at the tall woman beside Han Xiao. She was the owner of this floating island.

"It's the Dragon Emperor!"

Everyone broke out in cold sweat. Outsiders rarely had the chance to see Ames with their own eyes. Thinking of her strength and identity, these hoodlums could not help but feel their legs turn to jelly, and they felt an immense pressure.

The two of them did not even look at this group of people. They walked side by side, passed through the crowd, stepped onto the gangway, and entered the spaceship.

Hu …

The BlackLight Stealth quickly took off, turned into a stream of light, and disappeared into the vast universe.

Everyone looked at Ames follow Han Xiao onto the spaceship in a daze. Only when the spaceship left did they regain their senses.

"The Dragon Emperor went out again!"

"She actually went out with Black Star this time. He is the leader of the Field Team. Is Ames going to do something?"

"Black Star just arrived, and Ames left with him. I have a feeling that something big is going to happen!"

Ames' position was extremely high, and her every action would cause all sorts of guesses. These people who were stationed on Floating Dragon Island were all well-informed, and it was not hard to imagine that this piece of news would quickly spread to the ears of the various organizations in the galaxy through these channels.

However, for now, the news first spread on Floating Dragon Island, causing even more people to be surprised. Very quickly, it reached Jenny's ears.

Jenny's face was filled with confusion.

The moment she heard this news, she had a mental breakdown.

Ames often went out to play, but she always left alone. This time, it was different. She actually ran away with Black Star?

Just what did Black Star say to Ames!!

Jenny was so angry that her lips were trembling. Now that Black Star was controversial, she could already foresee that in the future, all kinds of troubles would come one after another, and the number of matters she had to deal with would double!

However, Ames was the boss. In the past, she could still bully Black Star. But now that the boss was personally stirring up trouble, what else could she do? Who could she reason with?

The corners of Jenny's eyes twitched, and her crow's feet were almost squeezed out.

So f * cking hopeless!

The spaceship entered the hyperdrive state, and Han Xiao stood up from the pilot's seat and turned to look at Ames.

"It'll take about ten days to get back to Blue Star. There's only the two of us on the ship. If you don't want to sleep, I'm happy to accompany you to kill some time."

"This ship is not bad."

Ames looked around and sized up the ship. Then, she turned to look at Han Xiao and smiled. "Is there anything to drink?"

The two of them came to the lounge, and Ames sat down lazily. Her long legs were crossed as she lay on her side on the sofa and supported her head with her left hand. She did not mind showing off her seductive figure in front of others at all. She liked to maintain a posture that made her comfortable.

Han Xiao opened the food cabinet, pried open the compartment, and took out a bottle of good wine that Ames had hidden inside. He then took out two glasses and placed them on the coffee table in front of Ames. He poured two glasses, then took one of his, and sat opposite Ames.

Ames hooked her finger, and the wine glass on the table was grabbed by her force field and flew to her mouth. She took a small sip, smiled, and said, "The taste is so bad."

"Is that so? I think it's okay." Han Xiao's mouth twitched. After all, Herlous was not a human, so his sense of taste was probably different.

Ames blinked, smiled, and said, "Let's talk about yourself. Ever since you joined Floating Dragon Island, I haven't gotten to know you properly."

In Noriose, Han Xiao had helped her capture Aesop, and Ames was very grateful. She was not the kind of person who felt that it was right for her subordinates to do things for her. Compared to the other three super strong people in the Shattered Star Ring, she was very casual.

A few years ago, she did not value Han Xiao and only allowed Han Xiao to join Floating Dragon Island because of Aesop. However, in just a few years, not only did Black Star gradually gain a foothold, but his strength also increased rapidly. Although he was still nothing compared to her, the speed of his growth surprised her.

Ames could not help but become interested in this officer under her command. Only then did she realize that her understanding of Han Xiao was close to zero.

Hearing this, Han Xiao casually talked about his background, naturally leaving out the information about the players. He started from the Germinal Organization test subjects, then the 'Inhumans' incident from the perspective of the Blue Star people, and then talked about his own officers. Ames listened attentively.

After talking for a long time, Han Xiao finally stopped and drank a mouthful of wine to moisten his throat. He was not against telling stories, and this was a rare opportunity to be alone with Ames. It was a good chance to get closer to her, and it was beneficial. Furthermore, Ames was a great beauty, and with Han Xiao's current strength, of course, he would not be controlled by her. However, it was still quite pleasing to the eye.

At least, it was much better than Harmon, who had thick hair and a muscular body.

After listening to Han Xiao's story, Ames' right hand lightly tapped on her thigh, and she had a thoughtful expression. "A pair of sisters who control life and death respectively. I seem to have heard of it somewhere before."

She did not care about politics, countries, or civilizations. Instead, it was the situation between Hella and Aurora that attracted her attention.

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. He did not hide the story of Hella and Aurora. In his previous life, Hella, who embraced darkness, was at her peak, and her deterrence in the galaxy was even greater than Ames. However, now that Hella was still very weak, there seemed to be something strange about it. Ames would not normally pay attention to the happenings of a primitive planet. If she had heard of something similar, the information must have come from a very high level.

"You just said that Aroshia is a life. Then, are the millions of similar Space Wonders also based on the same principle?"

Han Xiao shook his head and pretended to hesitate. "It should be different."

As soon as he said that, there was a sudden change in the lounge.

Buzz!

Streaks of light suddenly condensed into a human figure. Risda appeared and sat beside Han Xiao.

"Why did you run out?" Han Xiao was puzzled.

Ames' gaze also turned to Risda with a curious expression.

Risda slowly stood up and bowed deeply to Ames. His tone was sincere and urgent, and there was even a hint of pleading.

"Your Majesty Dragon Emperor, I hope to beg you for something. I beg you to help my civilization and save my race! I'm willing to pay the price and be under your command forever! "

Han Xiao had also mentioned the situation of the life civilization, and Risda knew that Ames was a major character. Her strength was on the same level as that Mechanic who had taken over his race, and she had the ability to deal with that person.

This was a chance to ask for help. Even if the probability of the Dragon Emperor agreeing was one in ten thousand, Risda was not willing to give up. If Ames was willing to help, everything would become simple. There would be hope for success in this seemingly impossible task.

"Fight?" Ames raised her brows. "Who's the opponent you're talking about?"

"It's a Mechanic who snatched my homeland and enslaved almost all of my race, turning them into his weapons. I will never forget his name. He's called Manison, Ancient One Papach!"

"Oh, so it's the Mecha Empire of the Primeval Star River. He's a member of The Ancient Ones." Ames shook her head. "I reject your request."

The Primeval Star River was a large Star Field like the Shattered Star Ring. The position of the Mecha Empire, Manison, was similar to the position of the Dragon Emperor, Ames, in the Shattered Star Ring.

The 'Ancient Ones' was a special organization, and Ames' adoptive father, Aesop, was once a member of the 'Ancient Ones'. However, he had left the group.

Although Risda was mentally prepared, he was still very disappointed. "May I know the reason for your rejection?"

Ames replied nonchalantly, "I can't beat him."

Risda's figure trembled as though he was shocked. "Even … even you are not his match?"

Han Xiao did not say anything. He was not surprised by this. Super was a general classification, and there were naturally strong and weak ones. Ames was very strong, but she was not invincible. Ames had never thought that she was invincible.

Ten days passed in the blink of an eye, and there was not much to do on the ship. Han Xiao chatted with Ames every day, and their relationship was much closer. The atmosphere was much more natural.

Blue Star appeared outside the porthole, and Godora frigates were guarding the atmosphere. When they noticed the Blacklight Stealth approaching, they immediately sent out a warning.

"Intruder, please verify your identity!"

"It's me," Han Xiao replied in the channel.

"Black Star, you can land now." The other party's tone calmed down. Although Godora was in a dangerous situation and had to be careful, Han Xiao had fought alongside them before, and he had already proven that he was not an enemy.

After being approved, the Blacklight Stealth landed in the Sanctuary. Looking down at the Sanctuary, it seemed that the number of refugees had increased again, and most of them were wearing restraints. During the time that Han Xiao was not around, Blue Star had encountered many dangers, but they were all resolved one by one. The players had done many things and lived very fulfilling lives.

Dark-star did not attack the calamity planets. Instead, it went to harass the other colonies, making the situation even more tense. Godora became more and more anxious, but this did not affect Han Xiao.

The cabin door opened, and Ames floated out. She looked around and said, "Is this your hometown? How nice. It's a pity that my hometown has become a deserted planet."

"The Inhumans are all at the plaza. I won't accompany you for now. There are some things that I need to settle first," Han Xiao said.

Ames nodded and floated to the plaza alone, curiously looking at the players coming and going.

A passing player subconsciously turned around and was stunned. His mouth was wide open, and his face was blank.

"Ai ai ai ai ai Ames?"

"You know me?"

Ames was surprised. She had thought that these Inhumans were all natives. She did not expect them to know her.

More and more people noticed Ames, and the players fell into shock.

The originally noisy plaza seemed to have been enchanted with some kind of magic. With Ames as the center, the 'magic' continued to spread, and the entire plaza gradually quieted down. It was like a spring that had been pressed to the bottom, and some kind of emotion was brewing.

Boom!

The next moment, countless players cried out in shock, shaking the clouds!

On the other side, Han Xiao did not leave with Ames. He quickly arrived at Godora's camp and requested to meet with Nagojin.

The Godora guard at the gate shook his head, and his reply was no different from half a month ago. "Black Star, His Excellency Nagojin is currently in an emergency meeting and does not have time to meet you. Please return."

Han Xiao's target was clear this time, and he said with a deep voice, "Immediately tell him that I have a new Mutation Source in my hands! I don't care what he is doing, but I want him to meet me immediately! "

The guard's face changed, and he did not dare to make a decision on his own. He quickly reported to Nagojin.

After waiting for less than two minutes at the gate, a golden light charged out from the depths of Godora's camp and stopped in front of him. Wherever he passed, a hole would be smashed in the buildings, and a deep trench would be left on the ground. It was Nagojin.

When Nagojin learned of the purpose of Han Xiao's visit, he was so shocked that he almost fell off his chair. How could he still be bothered about the meeting? He immediately rushed out to welcome Han Xiao, not even wanting to waste time walking.

"You … Is what you said for real?"

Nagojin's face was filled with nervousness.

Han Xiao took out the Mutation Source that was sealed in a transparent sphere, and it attracted Nagojin's gaze like a magnet.

"Let's go in and talk."

Han Xiao waved his hand to block Nagojin's gaze and chuckled.
